_meta.source: World Bank — World Food Security Outlook (microdata.worldbank.org/api/tables/data/fcv/wfso)
_meta.notes: Quarterly food-security outlook with historical 1999–2025, preliminary 2026, and baseline+downside projections 2027–2031. Methodology: Andrée et al. (2020). Covered 191 countries × up to 8 indicators × up to 33 years. Crisis-Affected Population numbers represent IPC/CH Phase 3+ populations (3-year centered average, smoothed).

crisis_pop.label: Crisis Affected Population (Number)
crisis_pop.indicator_long: Population in areas affected by food crises (IPC/CH 3+) (number) (3-year centered average)

emergency_pop.label: Emergency Affected Population (Number)
emergency_pop.indicator_long: Population in areas affected by acute food emergency (IPC/CH 4+) (number) (3-year centered average)

crisis_pct.label: Prevalence of Food Crises (Rate)
crisis_pct.indicator_long: The proportion of the population living in areas affected by food crises (IPC/CH 3+) (rate) (3-year centered average)

emergency_pct.label: Prevalence of Food Emergencies (Rate)
emergency_pct.indicator_long: The proportion of the population living in areas affected by food crises (IPC/CH 4+) (rate) (3-year centered average)

severe_fi_pct.label: Prevalence of Severe Food Insecurity (%)
severe_fi_pct.indicator_long: Prevalence of severe food insecurity in the total population (percent) (3-year centered average)

severe_fi_pop.label: Severely Food Insecure Population (Number)
severe_fi_pop.indicator_long: Number of severely food insecure people (Number) (3-year centered average)

financing_need_usd_k.label: Short-Term Caloric Needs Financing (Thousands)
financing_need_usd_k.indicator_long: Financing needs to meet the short-term replacement cost of 25 percent of daily caloric needs for the number of severely food insecure people (thousand) (3-year centered average)
